question: At matched actual measured inflow, does deliberately reduced cross-flow mean drag reduce damaging cyclic loads and improve net delivered electricity/reliability compared with near-Cp-peak operation?
mechanism: Lower controlled tip-speed ratio can change mean streamwise drag and mechanical Cp; reduced mean drag alone cannot predict cyclic structural stress or fatigue.
null_hypothesis: After calibration and matched conditions, no credible reduction in damaging load cycles with acceptable net electrical output is demonstrated.

comparator.rotor: SAME 1:6 cross-flow RM2 geometry (test rig prototype matched for validity, not fabricated published hardware)
comparator.source_mean_tradeoff_only: Candidate Cp approx 1.85 percent lower, mean Cd approx 5.51 percent lower, at nominal 1m/s tow tank; not tested structural or net electrical benefit.
comparator.mechanical_control: Time-resolved rotor angular velocity/phase and calibrated shaft torque; actual control system energy must be metered.
comparator.same_inflow_requirement: Match measured free-stream speed, vector direction, vertical shear, turbulence intensity, water properties, rotor immersion and test-section blockage; preregister tolerances before testing.

prospective_lab_envelope_assumptions.mandatory_repeat_protocol: At least two separate independently prepared replicate opportunities with randomized AB/BA order per matched condition are design suggestions, NOT statistically powered sample sizes; actual sample size and uncertainty plan must be frozen before running.
prospective_lab_envelope_assumptions.startup_shutdown_and_reversals: Separate preregistered transient regimes, not silently added to steady-state averages.
prospective_lab_envelope_assumptions.sample_rate: Must be selected from highest expected blade/strain harmonics and anti-alias verification, with synchronization error budget and published sensitivity. No arbitrary universal Hz is asserted.

mandatory_synced_channels.required: upstream water velocity vectors, shear/turbulence, timestamps and verified quality
water density, temperature, depth/immersion, blockages and wave state
rotor angular phase, direction and instantaneous TSR
blade-root strain in each critical bending direction, with stress transfer calibration
strut/support strain and vibration in relevant load paths
calibrated time-resolved support/load-cell forces; not just inferred from Cd
synchronous generator-side voltage/current waveform and power factor if AC
load/grid-side electrical power after conversion losses
positive and recovered actuator/control/PTO auxiliary consumption
safety trips, stop/start, loss of sync, sensor saturation, invalid samples and cable/maintenance incidents

uncertainty_and_blinding: Log original sensor serials, traceable calibration certificates, zero offsets, drift and instrument ranges before and after runs.
Record a common clock and worst synchronization error relative to the fastest targeted load cycle.
Run fixed setpoints in randomized paired blocks with any dropped/aborted trials recorded and reasons preserved; do not exclude bad structural cases post hoc.
Calculate uncertainty for paired load/power effects from independent repeats, accounting for inflow variation and correlation; do not call upstream exp_unc fields new confidence intervals.
Predeclare primary stress metric, cycle counting bin boundaries, replication and confidence interpretation before observing results.

required_outputs.operation: integral of measured torque [N*m] × angular velocity [rad/s] dt
integral measured net load-side electrical power dt minus all separately metered auxiliary/control draw not already accounted for
convert calibrated blade/strut strain to stress using validated load path
rainflow or equivalent cycle count with validated filters on time-resolved stress
Miner/S-N sensitivity ONLY if material-specific design curves and full exposure are justified; report sensitivity/unknown otherwise
matched measured electricity per fixed test duration; include non-generating states

falsifiers: Mean Cd declines but peak blade/root moment or damaging stress cycles increase or remain uncertain under matched inflow.
Apparent mechanical Cp benefit disappears or reverses after measured actuator/control and conversion losses.
Effect fails replicate/uncertainty assessment, scale/blockage control or measured loads exceed declared stop limits.
Wave/turbulence or reversal invalidates assumed lab generalization.

architectures.published_reference: RM1-OBS-001: published printed Cp table only
architectures.reference_area: rotor disk; report individual rotor and installed corridor

architectures.published_reference: RM2-OBS-001 and RM2-TRADEOFF-001: processed mean coefficients only
architectures.reference_area: frontal projected D×H; report installed corridor
required_specific: phase-resolved load cycles at both TSR setpoints

architectures.published_reference: foil_balance bookkeeping dimensional identity, no measured net energy
architectures.reference_area: actual foil span and heave stroke plus shared corridor
required_specific: simultaneous heave force×velocity and pitch moment×angular rate
control actuation consumption and regenerative handling

cross_architecture_common_gates: identical actual measured incoming control-volume flux and time window
separately report area denominators and occupancy/corridor
measured net electricity after all PTO/control losses
independent manufacturing/material source and teardown/service evidence
authorizations must be obtained before testing
decision: NO_SELECTION_OR_FIELD_DEPLOYMENT; acquire source-native current QC and actual sensor-controlled structural/power tests before any performance/fatigue winner statement
